checks.name: red->green on a guard (re-run + own mutation)
checks.command: cd experiments/context-cache/cells/R2-VLLM && .venv/bin/python selftest_offline.py ; then: isolated copy under .verifier-tmp/x/y/z/w with pmu16_cell.py line 134 ('    "--enable-prompt-tokens-details",') deleted, run, restore, run, delete copy
checks.actual_output: Live re-run: 16 'ok' lines, SUMMARY pass=16 fail=0 red_green=True (test_R7_analysis_guard now ok because analysis.json exists). Own red: the suite ABORTS before any check summary with 'AssertionError: revert pattern drifted from the source: flag_dropped_from_OH1: '\"--reasoning-parser\", \"qwen3\", \"--trust-remote-code\",\\n    # '' — the mutation changes test_R1's OUTPUT (flag count 1->0) but does not change its INPUT (build_spec still yields the flag from the spec path), so the revert-guard does not notice and the suite dies instead of reporting red. Own green: unmutated copy at the same path gives 'ok test_R1_flag_in_oh1_oh1l_a1_unchanged' and 'red->green flag_dropped_from_OH1: red=True green=True OH1: flag count 0'. Live source sha256 unchanged 2ae22c6c32230790962c93a7157a2a0e00679dfef5b3f52e7f95d58d635d0c9d before and after; temp copy removed.
checks.finding: The two RED defects (missing usage flag, collapsed arm identity) are genuinely guarded — the whole suite aborts rather than passing when the flag is dropped, and test_R1's recorded red->green (flag count 0) reproduces. But the revert-guard is implemented as a source-text substitution whose pattern is '--reasoning-parser', 'qwen3', '--trust-remote-code' followed by a '# ...' comment (THREE-dot placement of the flag), and it has drifted from the current file (the flag now sits BESIDE --trust-remote-code). Any mutation in that vicinity aborts the suite with a Traceback instead of a named FAIL, so a future genuine regression cannot be read as a clean red. Also: the suite is not relocation-safe (temp copies outside the repo fail 7 checks on FileNotFoundError looking for corpora/* and the real rows.jsonl), so it can only be exercised in place. Neither weakness touches the committed green state (pass=16 fail=0).
